title.narrative: Construction of the Guinea-Senegal Regional Road Corridor (Section Mali- Gadalougué) Republic of Guinea

description.narrative:
The development objective of the project is to contribute to increasing regional trade by enhancing the service level of regional roads and supporting population resilience. It aims to facilitate the rapid sale of agro-pastoral products, strengthen cultural exchanges, and promote social cohesion at national and sub-regional levels. At the sectoral level, the project will enhance the performance of the national and regional transport logistics chain, as well as the development of related services and trades, by improving the level and quality of road service along the corridor linking the ports of Dakar and Conakry. Specifically, the project aims to:
(i) Improve the service level of the Mali-Senegal/Guinea-Kédougou border road, thereby reducing the cost of transporting goods, vehicle operating costs, and travel time. (ii) Enhance cargo tracking systems. (iii) Ensure the availability of transport services and facilitate connectivity in agro-sylvo-pastoral areas (iv) Improve living conditions for populations within the Project's Zone of Direct Influence (PZDI).
